name: Cloudflare
summary: Workers, DNS, R2 and the whole API.
description: Cloudflare's hosted server exposes the Cloudflare API through search and execute tools, so the agent can manage Workers, DNS, R2, D1 and more within your account's permissions.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.cloudflare.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
